name: perfecteval
description: Provider-agnostic evaluation and review workflows for proving work is done, finding regressions, comparing candidates, diagnosing failures, and maintaining durable quality gates across models, agents, prompts, products, and repositories.

interface.longDescription: Run a provider-agnostic, repository-agnostic evaluation and review workflow that classifies risk, writes capability and regression evals, verifies evidence, performs independent review, iterates with convergence limits, learns durable review rules, tests user-facing work from a first-time-user perspective, diagnoses reproducible bugs, and finishes with a regression sweep. Perfect Eval works in ordinary ChatGPT chat without subagents and can optionally use fresh-context workers when a host provides them. Human-in-the-loop is the default; the user can switch the current conversation to autonomous mode and back at any time.
capabilities: Classify consequence-based risk before evaluation depth is chosen
Turn requirements, incidents, and bugs into capability and regression evals
Verify outcomes with evidence and avoid unsupported pass claims
Independently review work for failures the planned evals missed
Run bounded builder-verifier-reviewer loops with convergence rules
Convert repeated misses and false positives into durable review guidance
Test user-facing experiences from a first-time-user perspective
Diagnose reproducible bugs, prove root cause, and add regression protection
Compare models, providers, prompts, agents, and workflows under equivalent conditions
Use connected repository evidence without requiring GitHub Actions or a specific CI system
defaultPrompt: Use Perfect Eval to run the full evaluation workflow and prove whether this work is actually complete.
Use Perfect Eval to compare these candidates under the same task bank, graders, and decision rules.
Use Perfect Eval on this repository change, find regressions, diagnose failures, and verify the final state.

prompts: Use Perfect Eval to run the full evaluation workflow on this work and prove whether it is complete.
Write capability and regression evals for this agent workflow, then identify the highest-risk untested behavior.
Compare these two model or prompt candidates under the same eval contract and recommend one from the evidence.
Independently review this implementation for regressions the planned tests missed, and classify each finding by severity.
Run the full Perfect Eval workflow without subagents and show how every required stage is accounted for in the evidence ledger.
Diagnose this reproducible bug, prove the root cause, fix it if authorized, and add regression protection.
Evaluate this user-facing flow from a first-time-user perspective, including accessibility, errors, and recovery.
Switch Perfect Eval to autonomous mode for this chat, then evaluate this work without routine approval pauses.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-directory candidate for Perfect Eval: provider-agnostic evaluation orchestration with risk classification, capability and regression evals, evidence verification, independent review, bounded review loops, first-time-user testing, bug diagnosis, learned rules, session-scoped human/autonomous modes, and a complete no-subagent fallback.
